title: Hot take: arm pump
ig_caption:
Arm pump gets treated like a fitness problem. A lot of the time it's a harsh front end: the fork isn't absorbing the chatter, so you squeeze the bars to survive it, and your forearms are full by lap three.

Before the gym fixes it, try the free stuff. A click or two out on fork compression. Check your sag. Make sure rebound isn't packing the fork down through the braking bumps.

What's your front comp at right now?

title: Hot take: stock is a starting point
ig_caption:
Every bike leaves the factory set up for a rider who isn't you. Stock isn't wrong. It just fits somebody else.

Sag, then clickers, then ride it and refine. That's the whole game.

Still on stock? Be honest.
